uninsured_under65.label: Uninsured rate, under age 65
uninsured_under65.source: U.S. Census Bureau, Small Area Health Insurance Estimates (SAHIE)
uninsured_under65.note: Share of people under 65 with no health insurance. SAHIE is a model-based estimate that combines survey and administrative records; the margin shown is the 90% margin of error.

uninsured_under65_low_income.label: Uninsured rate, under 65 with low income
uninsured_under65_low_income.source: U.S. Census Bureau, Small Area Health Insurance Estimates (SAHIE)
uninsured_under65_low_income.note: Share of people under 65 in households at or below 200% of the poverty line with no health insurance. Model-based estimate; the margin shown is the 90% margin of error.

overdose_deaths_12mo.label: Drug overdose deaths, past 12 months
overdose_deaths_12mo.source: CDC NCHS, VSRR Provisional County-Level Drug Overdose Death Counts
overdose_deaths_12mo.vintage: CDC provisional data as of 2026-10-04; 12-month periods ending 2020-01 to 2026-03; one point per December plus the latest month; pulled 2026-11-09
overdose_deaths_12mo.note: Deaths of county residents from drug overdose in the 12 months ending in the month shown. Counts are provisional and tend to rise as records come in; CDC hides counts of 1 to 9. The Ohio figure comes from CDC's state file, which counts deaths that occurred in Ohio.

overdose_rate_per100k.label: Drug overdose deaths per 100,000 people, past 12 months
overdose_rate_per100k.source: CDC NCHS, VSRR Provisional County-Level Drug Overdose Death Counts; Census Bureau population estimates
overdose_rate_per100k.vintage: CDC provisional data as of 2026-10-04; 12-month periods ending 2020-01 to 2026-03; one point per December plus the latest month; pulled 2026-11-09; population estimates vintage 2025
overdose_rate_per100k.note: Our calculation: provisional 12-month deaths divided by the Census July 1 population for the year the period ends (2025 population for 2026 periods), times 100,000. Not age-adjusted; blank where CDC hides counts of 1 to 9.

places_depression.label: Adults ever told they have depression
places_depression.source: CDC PLACES: Local Data for Better Health, County Data
places_depression.note: PLACES measure: Depression among adults. A model-based estimate built from the CDC BRFSS survey and Census population data, not a count; age-adjusted. The PLACES county file has no Ohio figure.

places_mental_distress.label: Adults with frequent mental distress
places_mental_distress.source: CDC PLACES: Local Data for Better Health, County Data
places_mental_distress.note: PLACES measure: Frequent mental distress among adults. A model-based estimate built from the CDC BRFSS survey and Census population data, not a count; age-adjusted. The PLACES county file has no Ohio figure.

places_diabetes.label: Adults with diagnosed diabetes
places_diabetes.source: CDC PLACES: Local Data for Better Health, County Data
places_diabetes.note: PLACES measure: Diagnosed diabetes among adults. A model-based estimate built from the CDC BRFSS survey and Census population data, not a count; age-adjusted. The PLACES county file has no Ohio figure.

places_obesity.label: Adults with obesity
places_obesity.source: CDC PLACES: Local Data for Better Health, County Data
places_obesity.note: PLACES measure: Obesity among adults. A model-based estimate built from the CDC BRFSS survey and Census population data, not a count; age-adjusted. The PLACES county file has no Ohio figure.

places_smoking.label: Adults who currently smoke cigarettes
places_smoking.source: CDC PLACES: Local Data for Better Health, County Data
places_smoking.note: PLACES measure: Current cigarette smoking among adults. A model-based estimate built from the CDC BRFSS survey and Census population data, not a count; age-adjusted. The PLACES county file has no Ohio figure.

places_no_insurance_18_64.label: Adults 18 to 64 without health insurance
places_no_insurance_18_64.source: CDC PLACES: Local Data for Better Health, County Data
places_no_insurance_18_64.note: PLACES measure: Current lack of health insurance among adults aged 18-64 years. A model-based estimate built from the CDC BRFSS survey and Census population data, not a count; age-adjusted. The PLACES county file has no Ohio figure.

places_checkup.label: Adults with a routine checkup in the past year
places_checkup.source: CDC PLACES: Local Data for Better Health, County Data
places_checkup.note: PLACES measure: Visits to doctor for routine checkup within the past year among adults. A model-based estimate built from the CDC BRFSS survey and Census population data, not a count; age-adjusted. The PLACES county file has no Ohio figure.

places_food_insecurity.label: Adults with food insecurity in the past year
places_food_insecurity.source: CDC PLACES: Local Data for Better Health, County Data
places_food_insecurity.note: PLACES measure: Food insecurity in the past 12 months among adults. A model-based estimate built from the CDC BRFSS survey and Census population data, not a count; age-adjusted. The PLACES county file has no Ohio figure.

places_housing_insecurity.label: Adults with housing insecurity in the past year
places_housing_insecurity.source: CDC PLACES: Local Data for Better Health, County Data
places_housing_insecurity.note: PLACES measure: Housing insecurity in the past 12 months among adults. A model-based estimate built from the CDC BRFSS survey and Census population data, not a count; age-adjusted. The PLACES county file has no Ohio figure.

places_no_transportation.label: Adults without reliable transportation in the past year
places_no_transportation.source: CDC PLACES: Local Data for Better Health, County Data
places_no_transportation.note: PLACES measure: Lack of reliable transportation in the past 12 months among adults. A model-based estimate built from the CDC BRFSS survey and Census population data, not a count; age-adjusted. The PLACES county file has no Ohio figure.

saipe_poverty_rate.label: Poverty rate, all ages (annual)
saipe_poverty_rate.source: U.S. Census Bureau, Small Area Income and Poverty Estimates (SAIPE)
saipe_poverty_rate.note: Share of people below the federal poverty line. SAIPE is a model-based estimate that combines survey, tax and SNAP records, so it gives one value per year; the margin shown is the 90% margin of error.

saipe_child_poverty_rate.label: Child poverty rate, ages 0 to 17 (annual)
saipe_child_poverty_rate.source: U.S. Census Bureau, Small Area Income and Poverty Estimates (SAIPE)
saipe_child_poverty_rate.note: Share of children under 18 below the federal poverty line. SAIPE is a model-based estimate that combines survey, tax and SNAP records, so it gives one value per year; the margin shown is the 90% margin of error.

saipe_median_income.label: Median household income (annual)
saipe_median_income.source: U.S. Census Bureau, Small Area Income and Poverty Estimates (SAIPE)
saipe_median_income.note: Median household income in dollars of each year, not adjusted for inflation. SAIPE is a model-based estimate that combines survey, tax and SNAP records, so it gives one value per year; the margin shown is the 90% margin of error.
